env:
  shared_root: /var/cache/shared
jobs:
  steps-scope:
    env:
      CACHE_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/cache
    steps:
      - name: a safe assignment in one step
        run: |
          CACHE_ROOT="$(mktemp -d)"
          rm -rf "$CACHE_ROOT"
      - name: does not clear a delete in another step
        run: rm -rf "$CACHE_ROOT" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: |
          scratch="$(mktemp -d)"
          echo "$scratch"
      - run: |
          rm -rf "$scratch"
          rm -rf "$shared_root" # want:env-path-delete
      - env:
          step_dir: ${{ inputs.dir }}
        run: rm -rf "$step_dir" # want:env-path-delete
      - env: { flow_dir: "${{ inputs.dir }}" }
        run: >-
          rm -rf "$flow_dir" # want:env-path-delete
  other-job:
    steps:
      - run: |
          CACHE_ROOT="$(mktemp -d)"
          echo "$CACHE_ROOT"
      - shell: bash
        run: |
          go build ./...
          rm -rf "${CACHE_ROOT}/x" # want:env-path-delete
      - run: |
          own="$(mktemp -d)"
          shared_root="$own"
          rm -rf "$shared_root"
  quoted-arguments:
    steps:
      - run: go clean -tags "a b" -modcache # want:go-clean-cache
      - run: go clean -tags 'integration e2e' -cache=true # want:go-clean-cache
      - run: go clean -tags "a b" -modcache=false
      - run: sh -c "go clean -fuzzcache" # want:go-clean-cache
      - run: go clean -tags "a b" ./pkg -modcache
